Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the silicone container from mobile robot platform to workbench.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether the two silicone container is on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A lab bench scene. At top center a white sign with a purple end panel and QR-style code reads "合成工作区 / Synthesis Workstation", mounted on two black posts. Below runs a grey aluminium-extrusion frame/rail platform. On it stands an upright white plastic wash bottle with a red angled nozzle cap (capped) and a green band; it appears to hold clear liquid. Beside it lies a translucent plastic jar or beaker on its side, open and empty, with a white ring. Two white plastic caps/containers sit at lower right. At left, a black keyboard and a monitor showing a bluish interface. At right, orange-capped tubes in a rack on aluminium profiles. White wall behind.
observations: The workbench description mentions a wash bottle, a plastic jar, and white plastic caps/containers, but no silicone containers are explicitly identified.
